title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention uses Gaussian weights based on character distance to emphasize adjacent characters and captures directional information through multi-head attention.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention modifies scaled dot-product attention by applying a Gaussian mask that assigns higher weights to adjacent characters based on distance, enhancing localness and directional information capture. It uses multi-head attention to process different subspaces of input representation, similar to standard multi-head attention but with directional and Gaussian masking constraints. This is explicitly described in Text 4, Text 5, Text 9, and Text 10, which highlight the Gaussian weight dependency on distance, directional focus, and comparison with standard attention.
